measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measured the ability of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to understand and reason about physical-social norms in egocentric video contexts, focusing on categories like safety, privacy, proxemics, politeness, cooperation, coordination/proactivity, and communication/legibility.
